statement: Every registered invariant cites a contract the impact-contract registry knows: each of the 26 citations the derived harness model reports as unbound either receives a registration in test/shards/impact-contracts.json with exactly one witness test, or a ruled-out finding retiring the citation from architecture/contracts/invariants.json, so that no invariant remains that nobody can witness and the harness model's unbound count reaches zero by derivation.

constraints.statement: A registration names exactly one witness test that fails when the invariant is violated; a registration without a red-on-violation witness is not a registration.
An unbound citation is either registered or retired with a ruled-out finding; it is never re-pointed at an unrelated registered contract to make the number move.
The count is read from the derived harness model through scripts/checks/formation-contracts-registration.js; no list of the 26 is maintained by hand.
